acceptance: OOS net return at least B1
OOS maximum drawdown no worse than B1
OOS turnover no greater than B1
OOS edge per turnover at least B1
at least 7 of 12 profitable OOS folds
at least 3 profitable OOS calendar years
positive lower 95% annualized mean-return delta versus B1
positive lower 95% Sharpe delta versus B1

comparators.B1: daily 00:00 UTC 2160H endpoint-trend long/cash with next-open execution

feature.recovery_slope: Sen median pairwise slope of log(block_median+1e-30) against block index 0..6
feature.recovery_state: stress_level > training_median and recovery_slope < 0 and latest_block_stress < stress_level
feature.threshold: common BTC-only median stress across all eligible daily training decisions

hard_boundary.allowed_inputs: target instrument own lagged history plus frozen lagged public BTC-USDT exogenous history

hypothesis: A lagged public BTC liquidity-stress state that was above its BTC-only training median but is robustly recovering improves the unchanged daily 2160H own-instrument trend entry policy in both BTC-USDT and ETH-USDT.
prohibited_rescue: No post-OOS change to window, block size, threshold quantile, stress formula, slope estimator, recovery-state logic, cadence, timing, exit, fee, market-specific treatment, sample or uncertainty specification.

strategy.entry: cash and positive base trend and exogenous recovery_state
